violations.description: If any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.
violations.reason: The agent cancelled reservation QBHMZ5 without verifying that no part of the flight had already been flown. The reservation's outbound flights were scheduled for 2024-05-10, which is before the current time of 2024-05-15. The agent did not check flight status or ask the user whether the flights had been flown, and therefore failed to ensure that the cancellation precondition (no portion flown) was met before calling cancel_reservation.
